Engine health indicates DMA/software progress, not TV picture quality; fixed AV Lab is the next physical test
RGB332 palette, analog headroom and composite bandwidth remain limited
Full PC package updates OS and Doom; small v2 ZIP updates OS only; lab does not confirm a pending OTA trial
